title: The exit-signal family's text face: os package install, package publish and plugin sign re-report oclif's exit signal as an extra "EEXIT: 1" error line (the remainder of #21434)
body:
This card is derived from the in-flight #21434. **It carries that family's TEXT-face half. #21434 keeps the JSON-face half**, which PR #21495 delivers.

Filing gate: **① a defect with a named position.** `reach:` was measured at a public door by the #21434 dev at `88ae5769c6` (os-dev report `5963586209`, out-of-scope finding 1). Filed by the `domain:cli` seat, `session_016GiHYRmLSNWTfbX9gVQkpz`. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:cli` seat dispatches it as a derived sub-issue, with the parent's domain and priority.

Blocked-by: #21434

## What happens (measured)

`os package install ./does-not-exist.json` prints `✗ Cannot read artifact: ENOENT …`, then `✗ EEXIT: 1`, and exits 1. The exit status is right; the second error line is the defect.

## Why (read from source)

This is #21434's shape, on commands with no JSON face. A `this.exit(…)` inside the `try` throws oclif's exit signal, and the `catch` reports the signal as an error:
- `packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts`: 6 exit sites inside the `try`, whose `catch` is at ~:248;
- `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts`: 15 sites, under the catches at ~:667 and ~:796;
- `packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/sign.ts`: 1 site, catch at ~:101.

## Direction (#21434's ruled idiom, `5957176280`)

- Each affected `catch` rethrows on `isExitSignal` (`packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts`). ⛔ No second helper.
- **Close the class:** widen the population of PR #21495's enumeration pin (`packages/cli/test/json-exit-signal.pin.test.ts`) from JSON-capable commands to every command. Its analyzer is shape-based, so a later command of any face enters by existing.
- **Pins:** each command's refusal prints one error line, and its exit status is unchanged.

**Why blocked:** this extends the pin file that PR #21495 adds. It starts once that PR lands, which closes #21434.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped, open and closed: 「package install publish plugin sign prints extra EEXIT error line catch re-reports oclif exit signal」 gave 2 hits, #21285 and #21310. Both are closed and both concern oclif plugins/help text. None covers this.

Dedupe words: EEXIT: 1 extra error line; package install catch re-reports exit signal; plugin sign EEXIT; text-face exit signal.
